text: in my mouth: Heb. in my palate
according to thy wish: Heb. according to thy mouth | formed out of the clay: Heb. cut out of the clay
in mine hearing: Heb. in mine ears
he giveth not account: Heb. he answereth not
he openeth the ears: Heb. he revealeth, or uncovereth
from perishing by the sword: Heb. from passing by the sword
dainty meat: Heb. meat of desire
then a childs: Heb. then childhood
He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned: Or, he shall look upon men, and say, I have sinned, etc.
He will deliver his soul: Or, he hath delivered my soul etc. and my life
